messages.subject: popup offset in R leaflet
parts:
Hi, I'm trying to offset a popup using leaflet in shiny.  However there doesn't seem to be an option to do offsets in addPopups function.  I don't want to add the popup as part of an addMarker call (and use popup anchors) as I want the popups to appear independent of the markers (so I can have multiple popups for each marker in different groups).  

The workaround which I'm hoping to avoid is to add invisible markers with popups, which is also a problem as I'd like to use popupOptions which don't seem to be available when adding popups as part of the addMarkers call.

Any help appreciated!
